_readme: The three in-world log entries (asset A18), all written by Evan. Wording follows game/docs/STORY_SCRIPT.md.
Each entry: a title, body lines, a signature, where it is read and when it becomes available.
Not in decor_texts.json: tests/test_workshop.gd requires every key there to be drawn on a placed prop.
Nothing loads this file yet. The mission, console (Downlink tab) and dialogue code read it later.

kite_storage.title: KITE - STORAGE CHECK
lines: Battery isolated. Frame and gripper inspected.
Test the next wheel set under load before taking the crater-side approach.
kite_storage.where: workshop clipboard near Kite (optional prop) and the console's Kite tab

iris_field_note.title: IRIS - FINAL FIELD CHECK
lines: Radio supply is out. Stored observations verified.
The comparison logger is secured beside the far-rim marker, near the shade boundary. Its location is attached to this record.
Replacement stock missed this rotation; leave the mounts intact for the next crew.
iris_field_note.available: after the initial archive arrives (M2 dock)

logger_note.title: FAR-RIM LOGGER - ARCHIVED AUDIO
lines: If you're collecting this, check the shade marker before the return climb.
I put a second label underneath. The first one always gets dusty.
logger_note.where: at the logger (skippable audio with subtitles) and the mission checklist
logger_note.checklist_text: Check the shade marker before the return climb.
